description: Land Acquisition - Arandara, Galigamuwa D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically describing the acquisition of a specific parcel of land (1.6942 Hectares) in Kegalle District for public purpose. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, claimant information, and compensation procedures, which squarely fits the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) for land and property-related matters.
